title: Run a tenant-schema migration across all tenants: READ-ONLY on QA, only the refusals that start nothing
description: The platform administrator is refused, before anything runs: an unknown rollout id on the read (404) and on the resume (404), a start without its fields (422), a start with an entity type that is not an identifier (422, field entity_type, constraint identifier_format) and a start without the column type (400). A company administrator is refused the start and the read. NOT automated, on purpose: a real start adds a column to the schema of EVERY tenant and there is no undo (the rule of the migrations is additive only); the real run and its per-tenant outcomes are covered by test/letflow/routers/platform_migrations_test.exs. Nothing is created, so there is no cleanup and no residue; the fixture tenant is not needed.

steps.says: An unknown rollout id on the read: 404.
An unknown rollout id on the resume: 404, nothing is applied.
A start without its fields: 422 with field errors, nothing starts.
An entity type that is not a lowercase identifier: 422, field entity_type, constraint identifier_format, nothing starts.
A start without the column type: 400, nothing starts.
A company administrator may not start a migration rollout (403 or the uniform 404; the body would be refused anyway).
A company administrator may not read a rollout (403 or the uniform 404).
